title: NYC may require landlords and realtors to disclose the use of AI in listings
summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani is proposing legislation that would require landlords and real estate agents to disclose when they use AI-generated images in property advertisements, aiming to protect consumers from deceptive marketing practices.
problem_solved: Prevents landlords and realtors from secretly using AI-generated images to mislead potential renters or buyers about property conditions.
why_valuable: Establishes transparency in real estate advertising and protects consumers from being deceived by AI-manipulated property images.
